problem.name: Quantum coupon collection
problem.statement_latex: An unknown $k$-element subset $S\subseteq[n]$ supplies copies of $|S\rangle=k^{-1/2}\sum_{i\in S}|i\rangle$. Recover all elements of $S$ with constant success probability. A second model also supplies reflection about $|S\rangle$.
problem.statement_text: An unknown $k$-element subset $S\subseteq[n]$ supplies copies of $|S\rangle=k^{-1/2}\sum_{i\in S}|i\rangle$. Recover all elements of $S$ with constant success probability. A second model also supplies reflection about $|S\rangle$.

strength.description_latex: The copy-only advantage is logarithmic in the favorable support regime. With the supplied reflection oracle, the strongest regime has polynomial query advantage; both models remain explicit above.
strength.description_text: The copy-only advantage is logarithmic in the favorable support regime. With the supplied reflection oracle, the strongest regime has polynomial query advantage; both models remain explicit above.

evidence.description_latex: The cited results establish a classical lower bound separating the stated quantum resource bound in the specified model.
evidence.description_text: The cited results establish a classical lower bound separating the stated quantum resource bound in the specified model.

hardware.description_latex: The algorithm requires coherent input access and fault-tolerant execution of the stated procedure; its circuit and workspace requirements depend on that access implementation.
hardware.description_text: The algorithm requires coherent input access and fault-tolerant execution of the stated procedure; its circuit and workspace requirements depend on that access implementation.

quantum.headline_latex: $\Theta(k\log(\min\{k,n-k\}+1))$ copies for $1\le k<n$; with state reflections, $\Theta(\min\{k,\sqrt{k(n-k)}\})$ queries. These bounds are from Arunachalam--Belovs--Childs--Kothari--Rosmanis--de Wolf.
quantum.headline_text: $\Theta(k\log(\min\{k,n-k\}+1))$ copies for $1\le k<n$; with state reflections, $\Theta(\min\{k,\sqrt{k(n-k)}\})$ queries. These bounds are from Arunachalam–Belovs–Childs–Kothari–Rosmanis–de Wolf.

classical.headline_latex: $\Theta(k\log k)$ independent uniform samples from $S$ by classical coupon collection. The quantum benefit depends on $n-k$ and on whether reflections are supplied.
classical.headline_text: $\Theta(k\log k)$ independent uniform samples from $S$ by classical coupon collection. The quantum benefit depends on $n-k$ and on whether reflections are supplied.

plot.parameter: universe size n and unknown support size k<n
